business_summary: Target is a US general merchandise retailer with about 1,995 stores and a large digital business, with stores fulfilling over 97% of sales. Net sales were $104.8B in fiscal 2025, down 1.7%, with comparable sales down 2.6% on lower traffic. Results depend on US consumer spending, tariffs and import costs, and workforce costs, its largest operating expense.

pack_proposed.reason: Target is a general merchandise retailer (SIC 5331) whose demand, pricing and labor map to the general retail series.
pack_proposed.quote: We are a general merchandise retailer selling products to our guests through our stores and digital channels.

kpis.name: sga_expense_ratio
kpis.description: SG&A expense as a percent of revenue
kpis.reason: SG&A includes store compensation and is a key margin lever.
kpis.quote: Our SG&A expense rate was 20.6 percent in 2025, consistent with 2024.

kpis.name: cogs_ratio
kpis.description: Cost of sales as a percent of revenue
kpis.reason: Gross margin is affected by tariffs, markdowns and shrink.
kpis.quote: Our gross margin rate was 27.9 percent in 2025 and 28.2 percent in 2024.

edges.reason: Comparable sales driven by traffic and transaction amount.
edges.quote: Comparable sales decreased 2.6 percent, driven by a 2.2 percent decrease in traffic and a 0.4 percent decrease in average transaction amount.

edges.reason: Tariffs and merchandise costs raise cost of sales.
edges.quote: have resulted, and could continue to result, in us incurring substantial additional costs to procure a large portion of the merchandise we offer

edges.reason: Workforce costs are the largest operating expense.
edges.quote: With over 400,000 team members, our workforce costs represent our largest operating expense

operating_kpis_suggested.name: comparable_sales_change
operating_kpis_suggested.definition: Change in merchandise sales for stores open 13+ months and digital versus prior year
operating_kpis_suggested.quote: We use comparable sales to evaluate the performance of our stores and digital channels by measuring the change in sales for a period over the comparable, prior-year period of equivalent length.

operating_kpis_suggested.name: traffic
operating_kpis_suggested.definition: Change in number of transactions in comparable sales
